description: This file defines the ApiTester class used for API testing, extending the Actor class from Codeception. It includes methods for handling OAuth2 authentication, setting request headers, and temporary database operations related to accounts and contacts.

classes.name: ApiTester
classes.description: A specialized testing class for API endpoints, providing methods for authentication, request setup, and temporary database operations during tests.

methods.name: loginAsAdmin
methods.description: Logs in as an admin user by calling loginWithPasswordGrant.

methods.name: loginAsAdminWithPassword
methods.description: Performs login as admin using password grant.

methods.name: loginAsAdminWithClientCredentials
methods.description: Performs login as admin using client credentials grant.

methods.name: loginWithPasswordGrant
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 password grant login, storing tokens upon success.

methods.name: loginWithClientCredentialsGrant
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 client credentials grant login, storing access token upon success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Placeholder method for logging out the user.

methods.name: sendJwtAuthorisation
methods.description: Sets Authorization header with Bearer token.

methods.name: sendJwtContentNegotiation
methods.description: Sets headers for JWT content negotiation.

methods.name: seeJwtContent
methods.description: Verifies the response Content-Type header for JWT.

methods.name: sendJsonApiContentNegotiation
methods.description: Sets headers for JSON API content negotiation.

methods.name: seeJsonApiContentNegotiation
methods.description: Verifies the response Content-Type header for JSON API.

methods.name: seeJsonAPISuccess
methods.description: Checks that the response is JSON and contains no errors.

methods.name: seeJsonApiFailure
methods.description: Checks that the response is JSON and contains errors.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Temporary method for logging in, including setting authorization headers.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a test account record in the database, returns its ID.

methods.name: createContact
methods.description: Creates a test contact record in the database, returns its ID.

methods.name: deleteBean
methods.description: Deletes a record from a specified table by ID.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a relationship record in a join table using relationship metadata and IDs.
